runs.summary: Rerun with nothing changed, 1972 comes out as it did: Nixon wins, 520–17–1. The closest state was Minnesota, which went to Nixon by 5.5 points. Every one of my 100 reruns reproduces it exactly.
howIGotThis: The numbers: the 1970 and 1980 census counts interpolated to 1972 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 1972 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.

everyone.summary: 61.1 million more adults vote. No state flips. Nixon wins, 520–17–1. The closest call is Minnesota, which holds for Nixon by 5.6 points. McGovern wins in 0 of 100 draws.
assumptions: Every adult votes. Non-citizens choose like naturalized citizens of their state and sex; Black Southerners like Black voters outside the South; everyone else as their group did in 1972.
howIGotThis: What changed: Every adult can vote, and turns out.

The numbers: the 1970 and 1980 census counts interpolated to 1972 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 1972 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.
